setup: Feet shoulder-width, a light dumbbell in each hand at the shoulders
cues: Lower to the shoulders as you sit

name: Deadlift
setup: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, feet hip-width

name: Dead row
setup: High plank with a hand on each dumbbell, feet wide
cues: Row to the ribs, hips still
Single: one row per side. Triple: three rows per side

name: Upright row
setup: Dumbbells in front of the thighs
cues: Pull the elbows up and out to shoulder height

name: Clean and press
setup: Dumbbells at the thighs
cues: Drive the hips, bring the dumbbells to the shoulders, press overhead

name: Standing quad stretch
setup: Stand tall, hold one ankle; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
setup: One knee down on the mat; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Seated hamstring stretch
setup: Sit, one leg long; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Cross-body shoulder → triceps stretch
setup: Stand tall; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Child's pose to cat-cow
setup: Kneel on the mat
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Lying figure-4 stretch
setup: On your back; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Wall calf stretch
setup: Hands on the wall; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Chest opener
setup: Stand tall, clasp the hands behind
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Supine twist
setup: On your back; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Seated butterfly + breathing
setup: Soles together
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Standing side bend
setup: Stand tall; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Lying hamstring stretch
setup: On your back; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Pigeon stretch
setup: From hands and knees; switch at the beep
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Upper-back hug stretch
setup: Stand, hug yourself
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Sphinx to child's pose
setup: Lie face-down on the forearms
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch

name: Slow walk and deep breathing
setup: Walk slowly in a circle, hands on the hips or overhead
breath: Slow exhales, relax into the stretch
